name: overte-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Overte open-source VR/metaverse platform. Domain-server administration (verified live), in-world entity lifecycle (spawn/update/animate/delete), nearby search, fixture spawns and JavaScript script injection via WebSocket bridge (verified live). No simulated mode: tools fail honestly with bridge_not_connected or domain_unreachable.

badges.verified: All 12 tools verified live against Overte 2026.04.1

author: sandraschi

tools.name: overte_domain_status
tools.description: Retrieve connected-node telemetry and settings from an Overte Domain Server via /nodes.json and /settings.json. Fails honestly with domain_unreachable when no domain-server answers (no placeholder data).

username.description: HTTP Basic Auth username for the domain-server admin API

password.description: HTTP Basic Auth password for the domain-server admin API

tools.name: overte_bridge_status
tools.description: Report whether the in-world bridge is connected and how it runs (agent=headless persistent script, interface=desktop client) plus whether it may create entities (can_rez).

tools.name: overte_bridge_install
tools.description: Register the bridge as a domain persistent script so it runs headless (idempotent). Admin credentials from OVERTE_ADMIN_USER / OVERTE_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Then poll overte_bridge_status until connected.

script_url.description: Override the bridge URL the domain fetches. Default: this backend's /bridge/overte-mcp-bridge.js.

tools.name: overte_entity_spawn
tools.description: Spawn an entity (Box, Sphere, Web, Model, Light) in the Overte world. Verified live via WebSocket bridge. Supports permanent=True for cross-restart persistence (lifetime=-1). Fails with bridge_not_connected when no bridge is connected; never invents entities.

type.description: Entity type: Box, Sphere, Web, Model, Light

position.description: X, Y, Z translation coordinates (required in headless agent mode)

scale.description: X, Y, Z bounding-box dimensions in meters

model_url.description: GLB/FBX model resource URL if type is Model

script_url.description: Optional JavaScript behavior script URL to attach

parent_id.description: Parent entity/avatar UUID (MyAvatar attaches to the local user)

is_spotlight.description: True for a directional cone, False/omitted for omnidirectional

falloff_radius.description: Distance in meters a Light's intensity falls off by

tools.name: overte_script_inject
tools.description: Inject JavaScript behavior onto an Overte entity. Live when WebSocket bridge is connected; fails with bridge_not_connected otherwise. Every response indicates its data source.

script_data.description: Metadata parameters to inject into the script scope

tools.name: overte_entity_update
tools.description: Move, resize, re-parent, or toggle visibility of an existing in-world entity. Live-only (bridge required).

dimensions.description: X, Y, Z bounding-box dimensions in meters

parent_id.description: Re-parent to a different entity/avatar UUID

tools.name: overte_entity_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete an in-world entity. Live-only (bridge required).

tools.name: overte_entity_animate
tools.description: Loop-animate an entity in place: spin, bob, or real drop-and-rebound bounce. Server-driven over the bridge; blocks for duration_s. Live-only.

duration_s.description: How long to animate before stopping

tools.name: overte_nearby_entities
tools.description: Find entities near a position (defaults to the local user). Live-only (bridge required).

position.description: Search center; omit to search around the local user

tools.name: overte_fixture_spawn
tools.description: Spawn a preset fixture (box, cup, ball, table, chair) in front of the local user or at a position. Live-only (bridge required).

fixture.description: Preset name: box, cup, ball, table, or chair

position.description: Where to place it; omit to spawn in front of the user

forward_distance.description: Meters in front of the user when position is omitted

name.description: Override the entity name (defaults to the fixture name)

tools.name: overte_sampling_assist
tools.description: Get multi-step Overte operation guidance via MCP sampling when the host supports it; static plan otherwise. Read-only.

goal.description: What you want to accomplish with Overte

tools.name: overte_shutdown
tools.description: Orderly self-termination for agents and the fleet launcher. Responds immediately, then exits the process ~500 ms later. Requires confirm=True.

confirm.description: Must be True to terminate the server process
